summary: Navigation gained Memory search (Work, Ctrl+K) and Motion studio (Cockpit); the existing MemorySearch and MotionStudio modules are wired as full views and MemorySearch also runs as a Home widget.
Hash routes carry optional parameters (#/notes?item=id, #/settings?q=word). Search results and Home lists navigate with an item parameter; Settings opens pre-filtered from Home's readiness notice.
Global shortcuts are a pure, tested map: Alt+1..9/0 for the first ten views, Ctrl+K search, F1 help. They are ignored while any native dialog is open (keyboard audit K4).
Help dialog (F1 and sidebar button): every shortcut, every view with a blurb, and where diagnostics live.
Banners: safe launch now offers System status and Check again; a new Check failed banner appears when the capability check itself fails so readiness is reported as unknown, not fine.

Home: time-of-day greeting with optional display name; nine widgets with arrange mode (move, hide, show, reset) persisted per window; readiness widget hides itself only when the live check says ready.

Settings: a search box over a sixteen-section index that shows matching sections from every tab and jumps to them; new Accessibility tab (reduce motion, battery rule, text size, keyboard); Profile and Notifications sections; Home/End on tabs.

Onboarding: the model step can save just the endpoint and model and run the live Ollama check before finishing; the review step states Ready to answer from the real check or says it is not checked yet.

Motion: scene cross-fade and view entry are opacity/transform CSS only and are removed by the existing reduced-motion rules; the sidebar shows why motion is reduced (setting, Windows or battery) and Motion studio explains why playback is paused.

checks.result: ok (dist built; pre-existing chunk-size warning for the single 555 kB bundle)
not possible: AO desktop browser runtime stayed in BROWSER_RUNTIME_RECONNECTING; no visual check was made

route_params.item: Record id to select; sent to notes, tasks, capsules (saved record id) and assistant (chat message id). Receiving views may read parseHash(window.location.hash).params.item; they currently ignore it, so the screen opens without preselection.
route_params.q: Initial search text for Settings (Settings receives it as initialQuery from App).

nav.icons: The two new views take icons through the package namespace (Phosphor.MagnifyingGlass, Phosphor.Waveform) so tests/ui.test.mjs's fixed icon stub keeps building.

wiring.motion: <MotionStudio reducedMotion={motion.reduced} /> inside a page frame; reduced motion is the union of the saved setting, the Windows media query and the optional battery rule.
wiring.search: <MemorySearch state onNavigate> inside a page frame; onNavigate -> go(VIEW_FOR_CATEGORY[category], { item: id }). Ctrl+K focuses the search input after navigation.

props.initialQuery: optional string, pre-fills the settings search

shell_prefs.storage: localStorage through src/ui/prefs.ts (same prefix as other UI prefs); never secrets
shell_prefs.same_window_sync: useShellPref dispatches a 'shell-pref-change' CustomEvent so every reader in the window updates; usePref alone only hears other windows.

onboarding.change: Save and check now calls api.saveSettings({ localEndpoint, localModel }) without onboarded, then re-runs getSystemInfo and cloudKeyStatus. The trusted Windows confirmation for a changed endpoint applies as in Settings.

requests_for_other_owners: Notes, Tasks, Capsules, Assistant owners: optionally read the 'item' hash parameter (src/ui/nav.tsx parseHash) to preselect the record a search result or Home link points at.
Developer owner: the shortcut list can use VIEWS[i].shortcut instead of the positional index so Ctrl+K and F1 appear; the first ten Alt numbers are unchanged.
ui.test.mjs owner: the fixed icon-name stub still works; a dynamic scan like tests/onboarding.test.mjs or tests/autopilot-shell.test.mjs would remove the constraint on named icon imports in nav.tsx.
Native owner: a true desktop island (scope 61) and OS-level fullscreen/kiosk need main-process windows; the renderer's fullscreen button only uses the Fullscreen API inside the current window.

dependencies.notes: Only existing dependencies are used (react, react-dom, @phosphor-icons/react). The Battery Status API and Fullscreen API are Chromium built-ins and are detected at runtime; when absent the controls say so.

limitations: No visual verification: the AO desktop browser runtime was reconnecting for the whole session, so the preview at http://127.0.0.1:4173/ (vite preview of the built bundle) was never rendered. Behaviour is covered by typecheck, build and 144 tests, not by screenshots.
Item preselection from search results and Home links depends on the receiving views reading the item parameter; today they open the right screen only.
Text size uses CSS zoom on the app container; Windows display scaling still applies on top.
Battery-aware reduced motion only works where navigator.getBattery exists; the switch is disabled with an explanation otherwise.
Settings search matches section titles and keywords, not every field label.
Scope 61 (desktop island) and scope 66 (audio-reactive effects) are not built in this module and are not represented as built anywhere in the shell.
Owned files use CRLF in the working copy to match the checkout; the index stays LF through core.autocrlf.
